signals.pattern: (?i)(you have an error in your sql syntax|warning:\s*mysql_|mysql_fetch_(assoc|array|row)|mysql_num_rows|check the manual that corresponds to your (mysql|mariadb) server version)
signals.note: MySQL/MariaDB error text disclosed in response

signals.pattern: (?i)(unclosed quotation mark after the character string|incorrect syntax near|conversion failed when converting|invalid column name|invalid object name|microsoft odbc sql server driver)
(?i)(syntax error at or near|unterminated quoted string|invalid input syntax for type|operator does not exist|relation ".*" does not exist|pg_query\(\)|postgresql.*error)
(?i)(no such table|no such column|sqlite3?::|datatype mismatch|near ".*": syntax error)

signals.note: Generic SQL error wording; corroborate with a DB-specific signal
Delay must reproduce on repeated requests and exceed baseline by at least 4.5s
TRUE vs FALSE condition responses must differ consistently
SQL error leaked inside a JSON error object
DB engine resolved an attacker-controlled hostname (requires OOB payload)

preconditions: Response is not a WAF block page
Error text matches the backend DB engine, not a static template
false_positive_hints: SQL examples in documentation or blog content
Errors caused by malformed input that never reached the query
